newsitem.title: USA: TRO Learning names chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: TRO Learning names chief financial officer.

text.p: TRO Learning Inc said Tuesday it named Andrew Peterson as senior vice president, chief financial officer, corporate secretary and treasurer.
He replaces Sharon Fierro, who will remain with the company in a limited capacity until year end, but is leaving the firm to pursue personal interests.
Peterson was formerly chief financial officer for TSR Inc and chief financial officer for Duplex Products Inc, TRO Learning said.
TRO Learning develops and markets computer-based, interactive, self-paced instructional systems.
